items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: This was for the Volpe brothers? Yeah, uh-huh. We were working --

ctx.x: Well, a couple of -- about 18 months, I would say, because then I went to this Club Mirador in Homestead, Pennsylvania, with a band called, Leroy Bradley's Band.
This was for the Volpe brothers?
